variable.name: Air Temperature
variable.desc: Mean near-surface air temperature at 2 m
variable.plain: How warm the air is, about 2 metres above the ground — roughly what you feel standing outside.
variable.trend_means: Rising means the air is getting warmer on average.

provenance.access: Giovanni area averaging through NASA Harmony; regional CSV only

provenance.quality: Monthly mean instantaneous assimilation diagnostics; a different product from native mode. Cell weighting follows NASA's service.

variable.name: Specific Humidity
variable.desc: Mass of water vapour per kilogram of air — actual moisture content
variable.plain: The actual mass of water vapour in a kilogram of air — the true moisture content, whatever the temperature.
variable.trend_means: Rising means the atmosphere is holding more water, which can feed heavier rain when it condenses.
